text:
marta: Quick alert 12 vendor delivered a new rate file for the 'Assist Pro' offering (price_id=PS-26-AP-5). Need finance + billing ops review before shadow/canary. Link: https://vendor.example.com/sheets/PS-26-AP-5
liam: Does this touch reserved commitments or PAYG only?
sophia: We must keep legacy coupon mappings intact. Any change there will need approvals.
marta: PAYG only. Changes: invoice line rename, token tier bump for metered usage.
devin: I scanned the mapping CSV. Three exceptions: percent-off coupons, manually-invoiced enterprises, and accounts with metered_overage=false. Sample rows: ```acct_id,legacy_coupon,apply_new_rate
90001,true,false
90002,false,true```
marta: @billing-bot run a preview for cohort "assist-pro-experiment" (~8k accounts). Return invoice delta histogram + coupon collisions.
billing-bot: billing-bot: queued preview job=jb_7120. ETA ~9m.
eli: Vendor appended a termination clause. Legal pinged. Might delay contract sign if they don't remove it.
cara: Legal requested clause removal; vendor notified. Not blocking PAYG preview.
billing-bot: job complete: jb_7120. Summary: cohort_B median +1.9% invoice, coupon collision 0.08%. Outliers: 12 accounts with negative delta > $1k due to proration logic. Report: https://internal/reports/jb_7120
devin: I'll prepare a small translation-table hotfix to fix proration. Need permission to patch in canary.
marta: Approved for canary patch + validation. Abort criteria: coupon collisions >0.5% OR >50 accounts >$1k delta.
sophia: I'll generate stratified A/B cohorts by revenue decile; ETA 2h.
liam: Finance will run exposure calc after preview. Standing by.
marta: If canary passes, plan: 1% PAYG canary tomorrow 09:00 PT, shadow reserved. I'll draft runbook and comms for Sales. Keep notes here.
